source: desi-preview-hand-base.png, thumb removed with a smooth radial-edge contour, alpha cleaned, 0.5x
enters_from: top-right (wrist touches top and right edges of the image)

display.note: interpretation of the 20-24% brief: the four-finger span (index tip to little-finger outer edge) is ~59% of the image width, so 146 css px of image gives a ~86 css px (22%) finger span; nails render ~13 css px wide. If the brief meant the whole image width, use 78-94 css px (nails ~8 px). File is 511 px wide = 3.5x at 146 css px.

slot_convention.how_to_place: size the nail element to cell_width_frac_of_hand * hand width (aspect = cell), transform-origin at the sprite anchor (50% 92.5%), put that origin on `cuticle`, rotate(rotation_deg) clockwise. `center` is the same placement expressed as the cell centre (transform-origin 50% 50%).
slot_convention.order: index, middle, ring, little (visible top-left to bottom-right)
